notes.title: Where have we been?
notes.content:
Hi all, since there's been little to no updates and no communication on what's going on right now I figured everyone deserved a little update.

However before we get to that I wanted to thank everyone that has continued to play and support Fields, despite no responses from us. Neither of us thought this little project would do as well as it has and we're extremely grateful for the small success it's become.

Onto real talk now, the two of us have been very busy in our real lives and have had very little free time to really focus on Fields or any other projects. We've been experimenting with new ideas and new game designs, but we haven't been able to fully commit to anything. However, with a bit of luck we may find some time soon to begin developing something new, this means a new game may or may not be on the way soon.

Also, we're aware of some critical issues in Fields that, quite honestly, we've just ignored because we haven't had time to fix them. Hopefully these will be fixed soon and we apologise to anyone affected.

Thanks again to everyone who's supported us and I imagine we'll have something new to show you soon, so stay tuned!

Ryan :XYLogo:

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes + Fullscreen
notes.content:
Some of you have been asking for a fullscreen mode, you can now enter fullscreen mode after a restart by pressing F11. 

N.B: You can exit the game by press ESC.

Hope you find this helpful.

Fields XY Team ːCoolBlueDudeː

notes.title: Game is released!
notes.content:
The game is finally out!

Currently we're calculating the lowest number of moves for every level which is taking time. These will hopefully be done over the weekend.

If anyone finds a new lowest number of moves, please make a post with screenshots so we can update it in client. You will be credited for your discovery. 

Hope you enjoy and be sure to report any bugs and issues that may have scuttled away from us.

Thanks,

The Fields ːXYLogoː Team 

ːCoolBlueDudeː
